messages.author: f769d7d2cfcf4edc
messages.subject: Suggestion for manual
parts:
Hey everyone,

I just thought I'd make a quick suggestion for the manual. One thing I really like about R's docs about the various distributions is that it includes the expected mean and variance of the distributions in terms of the parameters.

For the distributions where such a thing would make sense, would it be too much work to add the E(X) and Var(X) for each univariate distribution given the parameters in terms of Stan's parameterizations? This would be especially useful for, e.g., skew normal, gamma, beta.
Currently, I either keep an R manpage open for the distribution (where applicable) or the wiki page for the distribution up, or I even plot the distributions in R using manipulate/shiny with curve(d[distributionName](x,parameters,...), ...) to better grok the priors.
